To request holidays at Nuvolar, you should follow these steps:

1. **Use Factorial**: All time off requests, including holidays, must be tracked and requested through the Factorial platform.

2. **Choose the Type of Absence**: When making your request, select the type of absence that corresponds to your reason for time off (e.g., Holiday).

3. **Request in Advance**: Ensure you request your time off with sufficient notice:
   - For up to **2 days off**, request at least **1 week** (5 working days) in advance.
   - For **2+ days to 1 week off**, request at least **2 weeks** (10 working days) in advance.
   - For **1 week off or more**, request at least **twice the length** of the requested time in advance (e.g., 2 weeks off requires a 4-week notice) [confluence](https://nuvolar.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/NuvolarHR/pages/3561455637/Time+off+policy).

4. **Consider Bank Holidays and Other Time Off**: When calculating your request, exclude any bank holidays, sickness, or other time off from your request period.

5. **Check with Your Team**: Before submitting your request, it's a good idea to double-check with your team and manager to ensure that the dates and length of your requested time off are acceptable.

6. **Out-of-Office Notification**: When you are on vacation, make sure to add an out-of-office time entry in Factorial. Your manager will automatically receive your request and respond as soon as possible. Additionally, set up an out-of-office email that refers to a backup person to contact in your absence.

If you have any further questions or need assistance with the process, feel free to ask!

23 days of vacation per calendar year + public bank holiday applicable for Barcelona. See bank holidays here. Check the Seniority Recognition Program since starting from the 4th year onwards vacation days can increase up to 30 days per calendar year. Carry-over policy: We are allowed to carry over 4 days from the previous calendar year. However, these need to be spent before the end of February. Depending on your seniority and the Seniority Recognition Program the carry-over may be different. Vacations should be taken in full/half-day blocks. Half days can not be requested on Fridays and during the Summer Schedule. Requesting vacation serves on a first come first served basis. Requesting time off should be done with sufficient time in advance: Up to 2 days off - request at minimum 1 week (i.e. 5 working days = 7 calendar days) in advance via Factorial. Be aware that Bank holidays, sickness, other time off, etc. need to be excluded from this request (i.e. 5 working days in advance) From 2+ days to 1 week off - request at minimum 2 weeks (i.e. 10 working days = 14 calendar days) in advance via Factorial excluding Bank holidays and other time off.
